mapper.sql: select id, bin_id, batch_id, product_status, total_qty from inventory_bin
mapper.select:
select ib.id, ib.bin_id, ib.batch_id, ib.product_status, ib.total_qty, wb.bin_name, COALESCE(wz.zone_name, wz_rack.zone_name) as zone_name, b.batch_no, s.sku_code, s.prod_name_chn as prod_name, w.warehouse_name from inventory_bin ib left join warehouse_bin wb on (ib.bin_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(wb.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR ib.bin_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = wb.bin_name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) left join warehouse_zone wz on wb.zone_id = wz.id left join warehouse_rack wr on wb.rack_id = wr.id left join warehouse_zone wz_rack on wr.zone_id = wz_rack.id left join inventory_batch b on ib.batch_id = b.id left join prod_sku s on b.sku_id = s.id left join warehouse w on b.warehouse_id = w.id
AND s.sku_code like concat('%', #{skuCode}, '%')
AND (s.prod_name_eng like concat('%', #{prodName}, '%') OR s.prod_name_chn like concat('%', #{prodName}, '%'))
AND b.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
AND wb.bin_name like concat('%', #{binName}, '%')
AND b.batch_no like concat('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND ib.total_qty >= #{minQty}

select ib.id, ib.bin_id, ib.batch_id, ib.product_status, ib.total_qty, wb.bin_name, COALESCE(wz.zone_name, wz_rack.zone_name) as zone_name, w.warehouse_name, b.batch_no from inventory_bin ib left join warehouse_bin wb on (ib.bin_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CAST(wb.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci OR ib.bin_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = wb.bin_name COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) left join warehouse_zone wz on wb.zone_id = wz.id left join warehouse_rack wr on wb.rack_id = wr.id left join warehouse_zone wz_rack on wr.zone_id = wz_rack.id left join warehouse w on wb.warehouse_id = w.id left join inventory_batch b on ib.batch_id = b.id where ib.batch_id = #{batchId}
select count(distinct bin_id) from inventory_bin where total_qty > 0
mapper.insert:
SELECT IFNULL(#{id}, (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 + FLOOR(RAND() * 1000)))
insert into inventory_bin (id, bin_id, batch_id, product_status, total_qty) values (#{id}, #{binId}, #{batchId}, #{productStatus}, #{totalQty})
